meta.name: service-mesh-observability
meta.description: Implement comprehensive observability for service meshes including distributed tracing, metrics, and visualization. Use when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency issues, or implementing SLOs for service communication.

copy.tagline: 监控服务网格的分布式追踪与指标,快速定位延迟问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在运行微服务架构,想看清服务间的调用链和延迟瓶颈。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor service mesh traces and metrics to fix latency issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run microservices and need clear visibility into service-to-service latency.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Istio、Linkerd 等服务网格的可观测性做法,帮你布置指标、链路追踪和看板,排查延迟与错误,并为服务间通信定义 SLO。具体模板在 references/details.md 里。
howto.when: 当你搭建服务网格监控、排查延迟或错误、或为服务通信定义 SLO 时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我给 Istio 网格配置分布式链路追踪
say.note: 会给出 span 与 header 传播的配置步骤

say.text: 服务间通信的 P99 延迟很高,怎么排查?
say.note: 会对照黄金信号逐项定位瓶颈

say.text: 帮我为服务通信定义 SLO 并设置告警阈值
say.note: 会给出阈值建议与告警项

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through service mesh observability for Istio and Linkerd: metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, latency and error debugging, and SLOs for service communication. Templates are in references/details.md.
howto.when_en: Use it when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency or errors, or defining SLOs for service communication.

say_en.text: Set up distributed tracing across my Istio mesh
say_en.note: Gives span and header propagation steps

say_en.text: P99 latency between my services is high — how do I debug it?
say_en.note: Walks through golden signals to find bottlenecks

say_en.text: Help me define SLOs and alerts for service-to-service traffic
